key_highlights: ASX slumps as bond yields spike; unemployment hits 5-year high, yet RBA signals continued hikes
AUD 'pulverised' by US economic strength; Trump trade policy (diesel export ban) poses material risk to Australian exporters
Gold exploration sector active: Auric, Aureka, Manhattan, Forrestania report high-grade discoveries in WA/Canada
Rio2 launches major copper drill assault in Peru; Sarytogan hits 452m copper in Kazakhstan
Housing affordability crisis deepens: rate rises locking buyers out for a decade; property prices falling on rising listings
Jetstar (Qantas) industrial action escalates with fee waivers; energy cost concerns persist
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags urgent tax reform need; data centre energy demand straining grid

sectors.trend: Gold exploration names (Auric, Aureka, Manhattan, Forrestania) showing strong discovery momentum; copper drilling (Rio2, Sarytogan) signals supply expansion. Rare earths (Lindian) nearing production. However, Chinese property recovery uncertainty weighs on iron ore/coal demand outlook.
sectors.implications: Gold miners benefit from safe-haven flows amid bond yield spike and AUD weakness. Copper names face medium-term supply overhang. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX exposed to China demand risk. Small-cap gold explorers offer speculative upside.

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish stance despite 5-year high unemployment creates margin pressure. Housing affordability crisis and falling property prices threaten NPL trajectories. Intergenerational Report tax reform could reshape revenue mix.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face rising credit costs in property. Higher-for-longer rates support NIM but cap volume growth. Tax reform may shift revenue toward capital gains/CGT.

sectors.trend: Fuel costs escalating; data centre boom straining energy supply; nuclear energy debate intensifying. Labor government under pressure on energy cost messaging. Trump diesel export ban threatens regional fuel security.
sectors.implications: SAP.AX, WDS.AX, AWE.AX benefit from energy demand. Data centre power demand (headline 30) creates long-term structural tailwind. Nuclear policy shift could unlock new capex cycles.

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action disrupts Qantas operations. Regional Australia hit by fuel costs. Consumer spending constrained by renter stress (50%+ struggling). Ozempic boom reshaping food demand.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational and reputational risk from Jetstar action. WES.AX, WOW.AX pressured by consumer squeeze. Regional retail vulnerable to fuel cost pass-through.

sectors.trend: Rising listings and falling demand driving prices lower. Housing affordability at crisis levels. CBD tower sales (headline 18) signal softening commercial property.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Residential REITs most exposed. Commercial property in CBDs under stress.

sectors.trend: Global AI chip race intensifying (Nvidia, AMD, Intel, SK Hynix). Data centre energy demand in Australia creating infrastructure opportunity. AI policy debate at G20 level.
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX exposure but data centre power demand benefits energy and infrastructure names. CSL.AX, WES.AX have tech-adjacent operations.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot vs. deteriorating labour market creates policy dilemma
AUD weakness driven by US strength and Trump trade policy uncertainty
Gold exploration sector in discovery mode across WA and Canada
Housing affordability crisis reaching generational scale
Energy transition tension: data centre demand vs. supply constraints
Trump trade policy (diesel ban) as asymmetric downside risk to Australian exports
Intergenerational Report 2026 signalling fiscal/tax reform urgency

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA continued hikes amid 5-year high unemployment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce cyclical exposure; favour rate-sensitive defensives (CSL.AX, WES.AX). Monitor RBA statement for dovish pivot signals.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Trump diesel export ban / trade policy escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; reduce commodity export-dependent names (BHP.AX, FMG.AX). Diversify into domestic-demand sectors.
Underweight banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX) and residential REITs. Monitor property listing data and auction clearance rates.
Shorten duration; favour quality dividend payers. Watch 10yr GBA yield as key trigger.
Avoid QAN.AX near-term; monitor for resolution. Consumer travel demand may shift to competitors.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply constraints from data centre boom
risk_assessment.mitigation: Long-term positive for energy generators (SAP.AX, WDS.AX) but short-term price volatility risk.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold exploration and production names
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade discoveries (Auric, Aureka, Manhattan, Forrestania) plus safe-haven demand from bond yield spike and AUD weakness

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy generators and nuclear-exposed infrastructure
opportunities.rationale: Data centre power demand creates structural tailwind; nuclear policy shift potential; fuel cost escalation supports pricing power

opportunities.recommendation: Selective copper exposure via Rio2 and Sarytogan
opportunities.rationale: Major drill campaigns signal supply expansion; copper structural demand from electrification; early-stage upside
Rate-hike environment and consumer squeeze favour essential-spending names with pricing power

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce bank and residential REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing affordability crisis, falling property prices, and rising NPL risk threaten credit quality and valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness and reduce commodity export concentration
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'pulverised' by US boom; Trump diesel ban threatens export revenue; China property recovery uncertain

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Qantas near-term; monitor Jetstar resolution
defensive_moves.rationale: Industrial action escalating with fee waivers; operational disruption and reputational risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure. Bond yield spike, RBA hawkishness, and AUD weakness create headwinds. Gold miners and energy names outperform. Banks and property lag. Expect volatility around RBA communications and US trade policy developments.
market_outlook.long_term: Intergenerational Report 2026 tax reform and energy transition (nuclear, data centres) offer structural opportunities. Housing correction may stabilise within 12-18 months. Gold and copper supply expansion supports materials sector. Consumer recovery contingent on RBA pivot and wage growth.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement tone
Trump trade policy / diesel export ban implementation
Australian housing data (listings, auction clearances, NPLs)
Intergenerational Report 2026 tax reform legislative progress
watch_list: 10yr GBA yield (key trigger for equity/bond rotation)
Iron ore and copper spot prices
